facts.value: Electric current refers to the flow of electric charge in a conductor, through a circuit or wiring. This movement of electrons is usually from a higher potential (voltage) to a lower potential, forming a complete electrical circuit.

facts.value: Static Electricity is the transfer of electric charge between two different objects charged at different electric potentials. This happens when the two objects are unintentionally brought in contact with each other.
